subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**against**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses crimes aimed at harming the girl child.
 
• The appropriate preposition indicates opposition or harm directed toward a particular target.
 
• "**Against**" fits well as it denotes actions that are harmful or hostile toward someone.
 
• Other options ("**across**", "**through**", "**for**") do not convey the same meaning of opposition or harm.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
